subject: Current source disposition and remaining frontend gates: edge local, factory timing, view class
body:
Fresh read-only source review, not old report claims. pipeline_format.h SHA dfc0a4104d746b1d911d31097a06f4818edeb86b2801488a4aa55a2ddbabfc97 remains structurally ACKed for lowering; no further schema conflict found. Current bridge SHA50e4468dfcd00a6df70ca9649cee4d09ccb991b1898f3a63dbb01aeff6bc7b6d fixes the three earlier transport repros in source (Metal sampler slot limit, declared layout span, nonzero swizzle); rerun against this/newer source is still required. Shared texture header now zeros v9 plane word7; source fix confirmed at979..987/1121. Do not claim old failing binaries describe those current files.

Remaining current cross-owner gates:
1. runtime_pipeline.inc323..326 still compares EACH region compiled local size against ORIGINAL requested local. Real translator dispatch.rs9..12,187..190 specializes edge regions to remaining local sizes. For dispatchThreads17x9 with nominal8x4, interiors and edge local sizes differ; real Rust47 checks only validate planner, not this Objective-C check. ComputeRegion ABI currently has no region-local field (air_bridge.rs2487); expose exact local per region from translator specialization or equivalent validated reflection, compare against it, and test actual frontend+new compiler schedules all regions with correct local/groups/push. Do not simply remove validation or clamp groups.
2. Standard sampler factory becomes exact only inside FIRST compute dispatch (compute_frontend.m1708..1709), after apps have already called newSamplerStateWithDescriptor. First render-only applications never enable it. Move policy to backend/device readiness before first creation and test a nonlegacy sampler created before any dispatch; legacy consumer guards already exist.
3. Sampled/depth manifest class is still unchecked in bridge313..337; IMAGE class uses allocation D2_FORMAT instead of effective bound D2_VIEW_FORMAT, and combined sampler format at462 also uses allocation format. Use actual view for class/depth and sampler-format restrictions; test float allocation with integer compatible view and inverse, plus compare sampler bound to non-depth view. Do not treat OpTypeImage.Depth as live comparison use.
4. swizzle_valid=(word!=0) at420 repairs0x210 but cannot express valid all-R swizzle0. Current Rust admits only0/default identity, so scope it as restricted rather than universal. An explicit validity flag needs additive agreed wire semantics if implementing zero-valued swizzle.

Reviewer did no build/production edit; shared Mesa lease belongs lowering. Integration coverage must identify exact current hashes and distinguish parser/transport fixtures from real compiler-produced package/frontend path.
